title: You Think Hearing No Ruins a Deal, Yet Getting Rejected First Triples Your Chance of Yes
description:
You think hearing no ruins every deal! Yet early rejection triples your chance of yes! This is the true story of psychologist Robert Cialdini's campus test. Here is what went wrong with polite asking.
